info.title: Keep API
info.summary: Read selected collection media, manage Keep protection, and inspect recorded operational status.
info.description: Keep's API covers selected Leaving and Kept collections, Keep protection, and recorded worker and job status. Send an API key in the Authorization header with the scopes required by each endpoint.

servers.description: Keep API v1 on this Keep instance

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Allowlisted media from selected Leaving and Kept collections only.

tags.name: Keeps
tags.description: Keep protection records. Deleting a Keep removes protection only.

tags.name: Status
tags.description: Read-only local worker and job observations for the current owner.

get.description: Lists the collections selected in Keep.

Lists media in selected Leaving and Kept collections. Filters combine; state defaults to leaving. Use state=all to search both states. Provider lookup requires provider, provider_id, and media_type. Embedded Keep data requires keeps:read and current access to that Keep. A null keep does not establish whether the title is protected.

parameters.name: media_id
parameters.description: Match an exact positive Plex media ID string. Results can include the same Plex title in multiple selected collections.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider namespace. Requires provider_id and an explicit media_type in the same request.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Exact provider ID: a positive decimal string of at most 20 digits for tmdb/tvdb, or tt followed by 7–20 digits with a nonzero numeric part for imdb. Requires provider and media_type. Numeric IDs require canonical spelling: no leading zeros, signs, or whitespace. IMDb requires lowercase tt.

parameters.name: media_type
parameters.description: Match movie or show metadata. Required for provider lookup, and may be used alone. Shows include upstream show, series, or tv types; episodes and seasons are excluded.

kept.summary: Kept title with an accessible local Keep record

get.summary: Read exact media from a selected collection
get.description: Reads a title in a selected collection using its composite ID. Checks both Leaving and Kept; Kept takes precedence if the title occurs in both. Returns 404 when the collection or title is unavailable. Embedded Keep data requires keeps:read and current access to that Keep.

kept.summary: Kept title with keeps:read and current object access

get.description: Lists your Keeps. The owner and Keep managers can also see other users' Keeps.

post.description: Protects a title in a selected Leaving collection. Indefinite protection requires permission to keep indefinitely. Removing a title from Leaving does not delete its media.

Location.description: Relative path to the created Keep.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present with the string true when the successful response is replayed for the same API key and Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Reads a Keep you own. The owner and Keep managers can also read other users' Keeps.

patch.description: Changes protection for a Keep you own or can manage. Indefinite protection requires permission to keep indefinitely. Temporary extensions follow the Keep's extension availability time.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present with the string true when the successful response is replayed for the same API key and Idempotency-Key.

delete.description: Removes protection from a Keep you own or can manage. The media remains in Plex.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present with the string true when the successful response is replayed for the same API key and Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Read recorded worker and job status
get.description: Requires the current owner role and an explicitly selected status:read scope. Returns recorded worker and job observations. Worker availability reflects heartbeat freshness; job records may be stale or absent when the worker is unavailable.

KeepBearer.description: Send your API key as Authorization: Bearer keep_<secret>. Create keys and choose scopes in Admin > API keys. Scopes do not override account permissions. Use HTTPS.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based offset. List feeds are capped at 10,000 records.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on writes. A matching method, path, and body replays the successful response for 24 hours. Reuse with a different request returns 409.

CollectionIdFilter.name: collection_id
CollectionIdFilter.description: Limit results to one configured collection. An unavailable collection returns 404.

ItemId.name: item_id
ItemId.description: Composite collection_id:media_id. The collection must be selected in Keep.

total.description: The complete matching result count, bounded to 10,000.

next_offset.description: The next page offset, or null when the result is complete.

name.description: The collection label configured in Keep.

id.description: Composite collection_id:media_id. Use this value for exact media detail.

media_id.description: The positive Plex media ID, represented as a decimal string.

title.description: The title supplied by Maintainerr, or Untitled when absent.

year.description: Release year supplied by Maintainerr, or null when unavailable.

type.description: Media type supplied by Maintainerr, or unknown when absent.

state.description: The current collection state. Kept protection takes precedence when a title appears in both source feeds.

entered_leaving_at.description: UTC time from a valid timezone-aware Maintainerr addDate for Leaving media. Null for Kept media or missing, invalid, or timezone-naive source dates. This is not a deletion deadline.

keep.description: Accessible local Keep record, requiring keeps:read as well as media:read and current object permission. Null when there is no accessible local record; it does not prove the title is unprotected or protected indefinitely.

media_id.description: The positive Plex media ID, represented as a decimal string.

duration.description: Temporary protection expires; indefinite protection has no scheduled expiry.

expires_at.description: Scheduled protection expiry in UTC, or null for indefinite protection.

extension_available_at.description: UTC time when another temporary extension becomes available. Null means no waiting period is recorded.

owned_by_current_user.description: Whether the account behind this key owns the Keep. User IDs and names are not included.

media_id.description: The positive Plex media ID, represented as a decimal string.

ProviderIds.description: Validated provider IDs from Maintainerr mediaData only. Empty arrays mean the source supplied no supported valid ID. Numeric IDs are canonical positive decimal strings. At most 10 distinct IDs are included for each provider.

tmdb.description: TMDB identifiers. Movie and television IDs use separate namespaces; include media_type when looking up an ID.

imdb.description: IMDb identifiers with a tt prefix and a nonzero 7–20 digit numeric part.

available.description: Whether the worker heartbeat is within the existing freshness tolerance (at most 300 seconds old or 30 seconds ahead). This is not full container health.

heartbeat_at.description: Recorded worker heartbeat in UTC, or null when unavailable or invalid.

id.description: Stable identifier from Keep's fixed job catalog.

status.description: Current recorded job state, including freshness and pending-request state. No job is run by this read.

last_run_at.description: Recorded completion time of the latest finished job attempt or connection check, or null when unavailable.

last_success_at.description: Recorded completion time of the latest successful attempt, or null.

next_run_at.description: Recorded next scheduled time, or null when unavailable.

last_attempt_status.description: Recorded result of the latest finished attempt, or null when unavailable. Freshness and queue state are represented separately.

queued.description: Whether a local manual-run request is pending.

interval_seconds.description: The configured job interval in seconds when known, otherwise null.

observed_at.description: UTC time when this local observation was read.

jobs.description: Allowlisted recorded job observations. No prose results, credentials, paths, or internal fingerprints are returned.

InvalidRequest.description: Request parameters or body are invalid.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, revoked, or inactive account credential.

error.message: An active API key and account are required.

Forbidden.description: Required scope or current account permission is missing.

scope.summary: The key lacks the required scope

error.message: This API key does not allow the requested operation.

permission.summary: The account lacks the current permission

error.message: Indefinite Keeps require current account permission.

NotFound.description: Resource is not found or not visible to this account.

Conflict.description: Another mutation is running, the operation conflicts with current Keep state or an earlier Idempotency-Key, or an earlier outcome is uncertain.

busy.summary: Retry later with the same Idempotency-Key

error.message: Another Keep or deletion operation is running. Retry later with the same Idempotency-Key.

conflict.summary: The key was reused for a different request

error.message: This Idempotency-Key was used for a different request.

uncertain.summary: Inspect current protection before another write

error.message: A previous attempt may have changed protection. Inspect the current state before making a new request.

Retry-After.description: When present, seconds to wait before retrying. For uncertain writes, inspect current state before making a new operation.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the 8 KiB write-body limit or the 1 MiB application request limit.

error.message: The API request exceeds the body limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: A write body must use application/json.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before another request. A retained-write-attempt limit can require a longer wait.

error.message: Too many API requests. Try again later.

InternalError.description: Unexpected internal error. Details and credentials are not exposed.

error.message: Keep could not complete the request. Check the current state before retrying.

UpstreamError.description: A required upstream read failed or returned incomplete data.

error.message: Maintainerr could not provide a complete collection. Try again later.

MutationUncertain.description: A prerequisite upstream read failed, or an upstream write may have completed. Inspect error.code: mutation_uncertain requires checking current protection before making another operation.

read_failed.summary: A prerequisite read failed before an upstream change

error.message: Maintainerr could not provide a complete collection. Try again later.

write_uncertain.summary: Inspect current protection before another operation

error.message: Maintainerr could not confirm the write. Inspect current protection before trying another request.
Keep is busy. Check the current state before retrying.

Retry-After.description: When present, seconds to wait before retrying. For uncertain writes, inspect current state before making a new operation.

MethodNotAllowed.description: HTTP method is not supported for this resource.

Allow.description: Methods supported by the requested resource.

ResultLimitExceeded.description: The complete aggregate exceeds 10,000 records. No partial data is returned; filter by collection or narrow the media search.

error.message: Too many records. Filter by collection or narrow the media search before retrying.

ReadConflict.description: Service or collection settings changed during the read. Reload the request against the current configuration.

error.message: Service or collection settings changed. Reload before retrying.

x-scope-descriptions.status:read: Read worker and job status. Owner only.
